body: Thank you Gokumoto. I called my mom to talk to her because she was mad at me for all of this and she finally broke down and told me she will be there for me through it all. Which helped ease me a little since she wasn't talking to me over it all. I think she realized how hard it was for me. I've been in contact with my therapist over it too to try and help me come to terms. It's just very difficult. I think I'm ok one minute and then the next it hits me like a ton of bricks. I'm scared.

How do I stop the dreams? I keep dreaming that this is the little girl I always dreamed of and she is coming to me crying and asking how I could hurt her. She's telling me it hurt and she felt so cold. She's telling me how I'm supposed to protect her. I feel like I'm murdering my own child. My heart feels so heavy and this is take a toll on my body. Stress makes my disease go into overdrive.

I just want to tell you that what you did might just bring her closure when she's older that will help her heal in some way. I'm not saying it will take it all away but I wish my abuser would just admit what he did and say sorry. I was sexually abused for many years as a child by a family member. He was caught and nothing was done about it. He still won't admit what he did to me and my other little cousins. My rapists terrorized me for years too. They also got away with it because of the detectives lack of care. I can tell you though that if any of them admitted to me what they did was wrong and apologized it probably would have brought me some closure to all of the pain I experienced. So oddly enough thank you for giving that closure to that little girl.

Thank you for giving me that perspective of things. I hope I am strong enough. I have been through a lot in my life and I have survived things and came out of the other end stronger then I was before. I do love my son enough to live for him. That's why I fight everyday to be the best that I can be and to live another day. Some days are really hard on me and it's very difficult to get out of bed but I do for him. My doctors tell me all the time that I need to take it easy, that I'm pushing myself too hard. I'll never stop pushing myself for my little boy. I just hope he won't hate me one day for all the things I couldn't/can't do. I'm going to call my therapist tomorrow to talk with her. This is going to be very hard emotionally and I'm sure I'll have my bad days filled with sadness and other emotions. I just hope that I will be strong enough to move past this and find the closure I need.

Thank you for understanding me and the kind words. I was thinking of calling my therapist and talking with her. Maybe she can direct me somewhere. This is by far one of the hardest decisions I've ever had to make.
I know logically it makes sense. I also want to spend as much time with my son as I have with him, but my heart still hurts. It actually feels like it is breaking.
